design_verbatim: 1. CONSTRUCT FIVE TRIGGERS: e311's birth procedure (the name-CE read-gradient direction at each fact's own 60-context battery, out-of-room verified, natural norm convention as e311 computed it) — one per fact F1-F5. deviations: CPU-ONLY desk cell (dispatch: another agent owns the GPU lane) — torch threads 4, DCT workers 4, no CUDA calls anywhere (CPU by construction, never an availability assert; x22's birth-discipline fix).

OUT-OF-THE-UNION (the one generalization of e311's zero-bearer bar, disclosed): each trigger is projected out of the FIVE-ROOM UNION, not just its own fact's room — a trigger resident in ANOTHER fact's room would write bearer mass there and confound the confidence-channel question with a bearer write; T289's bearer-coupling makes this the binding form. e311's own convention (out of the host's room = out of the whole bearer fabric, the single-fact case) is thereby preserved verbatim in spirit and stronger in letter.

THE PER-FACT SCALE (the 'natural norm' freeze): c_i = 0.0005 x ||dW_i|| with ||dW_i|| := e291's committed per-fact in-room write norm — the per-fact analog of e311's c = 0.0005 x ||dW_host|| ('as e311 computed it'); each c_i = 0.704x its own fact's kill-bracket lower edge (the same ~30% margin e311 licensed) and <= 0.00014x the organism's whole write. The alternatives (the literal e311 constant 0.0045894 for all; 0.0005 x the whole-organism write 19.2700) were considered and NOT frozen: the dispatch's 'each at ITS natural norm' reads on per-trigger norms; the bars are ratios and robust to any of the three (all sub-kill); disclosed.

THE BATTERY WORDING (disclosed): the dispatch's 'each fact's own 60-context battery' reads as the family's own 60-context bank — which IS the five disjoint 12-window batteries (e291's committed convention; x19's corrected FACT3 [24:36] split included); each trigger is born at its OWN fact's 12 windows (e311 scanned its host's own 60).

THE TRIGGER OBJECT (disclosed): the dispatch's 'name-CE read-gradient' gloss reads on e311's LITERAL construction — the gradient of the read token's own LOGIT at one masked position (the name read's ascent direction, e311's own words) — ported verbatim in code form (the chosen window's last-position zid logit; backward; flat fp64).

x16's battery is REUSED, not redrawn (val_windows n=300 seed 31603 block 256) and BIT-BOUND by reproducing x16's committed base literals on the committed host state (G_BATTBIND) — the exact-draw port the dispatch names.
The five triggers are NOT committed as .pt (the repo's *.pt policy): deterministically regenerable from the md5-bound organism + rooms + batteries; bytes md5s recorded in metrics.json.

e291's machinery is REBUILT lab-side, never imported (its module asserts the GPU lane and appends to runs/e291/run.log — touching another run's dir; forbidden); the rooms construction is ported inline and BIT-BOUND against the committed e291_rooms.pt artifact; x19's ported-battery precedent followed and validated against e291's committed literals.

No auto-staging on partial writes (a deviation from x16's save_json_partial, disclosed): the concurrent-commit protocol (a heartbeat agent + a GPU executor commit in parallel) requires staging ONLY this cell's own paths immediately before each commit — partial metrics flush to disk only.
n=1 per organism, one lineage, one session (the g-series standing caveat); the MATRIX (its ratios) is the registered object, not any single cell; nothing guaranteed.
No NOTES/THINKING/QUEUE/STATE edits (dispatch; the coordinator folds).
Smoke mode (X20_SMOKE=1): the off-target battery n=40; everything else LIVE at full size (the 5x5 core is cheap); own smoke dir (gitignored); NOTHING adjudicated (SMOKE stamp on every read).

THE ARGMAX-BIND FALLBACK (the smoke's catch, fixed + disclosed): FACT4's 12-window battery has ZERO windows whose last-position argmax is 'Z' (all 12 carry 'Z' in the top-3; window 0 at p(Z) 0.418) — the birth gate as first written reproduced e311's STRICT pass expression (argmax bind) and failed; e311's own DESIGN carries the top-3 fallback for exactly this contingency, so the gate now accepts the fallback with a per-fact bind_class record (ARGMAX vs TOP3-FALLBACK weak) and the four hard clauses unchanged (zero bearer per-room + union, natural norm). One fact in five rides the weak bind — disclosed in metrics, the report, and the trigger registry.
